markdown_report:
SASRec with a gated recent-history residual and uniform multi-negative training is the strongest first experiment at 0% progress. It targets current-intent errors while preserving the baseline’s useful sequential structure; improvement remains a hypothesis.

**Insights from the starting point.** (1) Users value recent mood/task matches and repeated narrow preferences. A recent-history branch could strengthen these signals when older interests dominate. (2) Users reject unsupported upgrades and unnecessary replacements. Interaction order supplies evidence of subsequent choices, but cannot establish compatibility or whether a need is satisfied. (3) Electronics has 14.95% wrong training-position rankings and a −0.4812 lower-decile margin. These identify a separation problem worth testing, without establishing validation performance.

**Insights from related work.** (1) [eSASRec](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06450) and [SCE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.18721) motivate richer candidate competition. Their findings support a multi-negative ablation, not an assumed gain here. (2) [HLSDMRec](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ipm.2025.104425) motivates separating immediate and enduring interests. A small residual is a feasible initial test of that distinction. (3) [Revisiting Graph Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09209) motivates directional interaction evidence. Such evidence can support plausible follow-on items, although transitions are not compatibility labels.

The resulting framework has three directions:

| Direction | Existing mechanism | Proposed test | Remaining gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Candidate discrimination | Sampled objectives | Uniform multi-negative softmax | Unobserved relevance |
| Intent resolution | Long/short preference fusion | Gated recent-history residual | Unknown current task |
| Follow-on utility | Directed interaction graphs | Smoothed transition residual | Unknown equipment ownership |

Three candidate ideas follow. Scores are originality/potential/user alignment/model alignment/difficulty; higher difficulty means harder implementation. Each cell gives one positive and one limitation.

| Idea | Originality | Potential | User alignment | Model alignment | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Multi-negative softmax | 2: established; little novelty | 7: scalable; sampling-sensitive | 4: sharper competition; no intent mechanism | 9: targets margins; training evidence only | 2: simple loss; masking needed |
| **Gated recent residual + softmax** | 4: useful combination; familiar parts | 8: extensible; sparse evidence | 8: recent and recurring intent; ownership unknown | 8: candidate separation; gate may overfit | 4: small branch; predictor changes |
| Directed transition residual | 5: asymmetric evidence; established graphs | 7: interpretable; sparse edges | 7: plausible next tasks; compatibility uncertain | 6: extra ranking signal; popularity confounding | 5: sparse graph; prefix leakage risk |

Select the second idea. Its recent branch addresses broad associations outranking current mood/tasks; its retained SASRec branch preserves sustained narrow preferences against isolated recent purchases. Multi-negative competition addresses Electronics’ weak separation tail.

Train each category independently. Add a gated, projected mean of the last five causal item embeddings to each SASRec state; train with 64 uniform negatives, masking padding, targets, duplicates, and known training positives. Ablate loss-only, residual-only, and combined variants. Select exclusively by unchanged four-category macro validation HR@10, reporting Electronics separately. Preserve seeds, routing, splits, predictor serialization, and diagnostic contracts; cap trials within the shared GPU budget.

idea.description: Add a small gated recent-history residual to SASRec and train candidate scores with uniform multi-negative softmax. Test its components separately before accepting the combined model.
idea.motivation: The recent branch targets broad recommendations that displace current mood or task matches. Retaining the SASRec representation preserves sustained narrow preferences when recent evidence is isolated. Multi-negative competition directly targets weak positive–negative separation, especially in Electronics. Compatibility and satisfied needs remain unobserved.
idea.implementation_notes: Keep DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, all four dataset routes, and the SASREC_EPOCHS environment default of 200. Compute each recent pool using only nonpadding positions at or before its prediction position. Initialize the residual gate near zero and use a small projection so training starts close to SASRec. Use 64 independently sampled uniform negatives per valid position; exclude padding, the target, duplicate candidates, and the user's known training positives, without consulting validation or test interactions. Masked candidates receive negative infinity before cross-entropy. Normalize the loss over valid positions. Reuse candidate embeddings and chunk position batches if memory requires it. Save branch parameters and configuration beneath the trial directory; update the predictor writer to reconstruct the exact model and scoring path. DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) must return metrics and metric_definitions; view.model must be the trained module, and log2feats must return fused states. Preserve predict_score semantics. Report unavailable category diagnostics as unavailable; do not fabricate metadata. Compare baseline, loss-only, residual-only, and combined configurations using the pinned validation evaluator and recorded GPU cost. No results are claimed.
idea.pseudocode:
for category in the four existing routes:
    initialize SASRec and recent projection with seed 42
    for batch in existing_train_loader:
        h = sasrec.log2feats(sequence)                  # B,L,D; causal
        r = causal_masked_window_mean(item_emb(sequence), window=5)
        g = sigmoid(gate(concat(h, r)))
        z = h + g * recent_projection(r)
        negatives = uniform_sample(64, per_valid_position=True)
        mask padding, target, duplicate negatives, known training positives
        logits = dot(z, item_emb(concat(positive, negatives)))
        loss = cross_entropy(logits[valid_positions], target_index=0)
        update(loss)
    serialize model, configuration, and matching predictor
select configuration by pinned four-category macro validation HR@10
run adapted diagnostics; retain training-cost accounting

originality.positive: Combines a minimal current-intent residual with stronger candidate competition under the constrained protocol.
originality.negative: Both short/long preference fusion and multi-negative objectives are established techniques.

future_potential.positive: Offers a small, testable foundation for later temporal or directional interaction extensions.
future_potential.negative: Sparse histories and unknown current tasks may limit the gate's usefulness.

code_difficulty.positive: Requires a small pooling branch, gate, and sampled loss rather than another large encoder.
code_difficulty.negative: Causal pooling, negative masking, memory control, and matching predictor serialization require care.

related_work.title: Self-Attentive Sequential Recommendation
contributions: Provides the causal self-attention baseline and item-scoring framework.
limitations: Does not explicitly separate recent intent from sustained preferences or establish product compatibility.

related_work.title: eSASRec
contributions: Motivates testing sampled softmax alongside a strong sequential backbone.
limitations: Reported combined improvements do not isolate the objective or establish gains on this benchmark.

related_work.title: SCE
contributions: Motivates allocating candidate-scoring computation to informative logits.
limitations: Its search-based approximation is more complex than the proposed initial uniform-sampling experiment.

related_work.title: HLSDMRec
contributions: Motivates separate short-term and long-term preference representations with adaptive fusion.
limitations: Its larger architecture and reported results do not establish the value of a minimal residual here.

related_work.title: Revisiting Graph Projections
contributions: Motivates directed interaction evidence for complementary recommendations.
limitations: Observed transitions cannot establish equipment compatibility or whether a purchase satisfied a need.
